tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Learn what you will build, the workshop scope, and the required prerequisites.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to your Oracle Cloud account and prepare to use your tenancy.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Create the OCI Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and MySQL HeatWave Environment
tutorials.description: Create Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and a private MySQL HeatWave DB System configured for MySQL HeatWave GenAI.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create the Workbook-Style Database Schema
tutorials.description: Download the application source and create the complete persistence schema and least-privilege PHP account.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Deploy the PHP Foundation and Saved-Input Workflow
tutorials.description: Deploy the secure PHP foundation and create, list, and reopen complete RHEL and Oracle Linux inputs.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Enable GenAI Formatting and Representative Review
tutorials.description: Use ML_GENERATE to create validated suggestions, then correct, align, decide, and use manual fallback.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Calculate, Save, and Manage the Complete Comparison
tutorials.description: Calculate traceable results and enable reopen, revision, duplication, and CSV workbook export.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Test and Demonstrate the Complete Application
tutorials.description: Run executable verification, test fail-closed scenarios, and rehearse the complete prototype demonstration.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common problems and find directions for receiving help.
